name: Piecewise Linear LOD Transition
definition: A method to weight hash grid features from multiple LOD levels based on an optimal LOD level $L^*$, allowing smooth transitions between detail levels to reduce rendering time for distant points while preserving high-frequency features for close points.
summary: Piecewise Linear LOD Transition weights hash grid features using a piecewise linear function derived from the Nyquist–Shannon sampling theorem to smoothly blend discrete LOD levels.
